anchorFollowup.defect: Babylon billboard composition ignores its parent orientation for a nonzero child offset, moving label origins above downward/lateral arrows.
anchorFollowup.behavior: A non-billboard tip TransformNode under the rotated glyph carries the offset. Its zero-position billboard child changes facing while retaining the actual transformed tip anchor.
anchorFollowup.regression: Active camera, downward/lateral vectors, nonuniform parent scale, rotation and rebasing; actual absolute label position within 0.1 mm of the transformed vector tip, with billboard normal still aligned with the camera.

initialToleranceFailure.reason: Float32 hierarchical matrices at approximately 300 m offsets cannot promise 10 micrometre accuracy; the final assertion remains below 0.1 mm.

directionFollowup.defect: Babylon default antiparallel epsilon 0.001 snaps normalized directions within approximately 2.56 degrees of down to exactly down.
directionFollowup.hardwareReproduction: Consumer assertion measured approximately 0.315 m label/expected-vector-tip error for a 2.1 degree tilted native weight vector on both GPU backends.
directionFollowup.behavior: Pass 4 * Number.EPSILON explicitly to the helper comparison of 1 + normalized dot product. Preserve measurable near-down components while keeping the finite exact-down fallback.
directionFollowup.regression: Actual arrow-head tips and normalized directions for 2.1 degree near-down, sub-microradian near-down and exact-down inputs. Active-camera, rotated/scaled/rebased label anchoring also includes the near-down vector.
